title: Q-SPEC-02-R12-never-lists: Give every role file the three-item never list and check it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q "US-02-R12" -- seed/tests tests/foundation
**Status:** closed

US-SPEC-02 (US-02-R12): every role instruction file must carry a never list naming acting on another agent's live claim, handling secret values and reviewing one's own work. The rules are in `agents/AGENTS.md`; no file in `seed/agents/roles/` names all three and nothing checks it. Add the list through the role-file generator (`python3 -m foundation managers --sync` keeps the generated block) to `agents/roles/` and `seed/agents/roles/`, and add a seed test that reads every role file for the three rules.

size: M

**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.9 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** rewriting what each role owns or its loops.

**Closing probe:** cmd:`git grep -q "US-02-R12" -- seed/tests tests/foundation` exits 0, and `python3 scripts/spec_ids.py --check` passes with the status line of the specification changed from PLANNED to BUILT naming the file and the test.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:19:27Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
